meta.source: First sound (perceived latency, end of speech to first audio, p50): hub-class machine 1503 ms from .claude/docs/domia-current-state.md 2026-09-11 (Jetson sat-bench-7, n=48); fast desktop 1007 ms from domia-core/evals/bench-results/sat-bench-15.json summary.perceived_ttfa_ms (n=48, 2026-09-11). Known command on the hub-class machine: 600-800 ms perceived from .claude/docs/domia-current-state.md 2026-09-10 (real house); not measured on the fast desktop. Fast desktop stage offsets from sat-bench-15.json summary p50 (d_endpoint 351, d_stt_final 101, d_prompt_ready 4, d_first_token 123, d_tts_first_unit 62). Hub stage offsets from baseline-jetson-2b.json d_endpoint p50 353, .claude/docs/roadmap-2026.md (Jetson d_stt_final p50 219 ms, TTFT p50 291 ms, fast-path HassTurnOff 2 ms match); fast desktop TTFT 63-110 ms from roadmap-2026.md (63 ms warm) and sat-bench-15.json llm_ttft_ms p50 110.
